seoTitle: Boise School District Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates & Breaks
seoDescription: Find Boise School District’s 2026–27 first and last days, breaks, Pre-K and ECSE dates, early-release times, conferences, and official calendar sources.
heroSummary: Boise School District K–12 students begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026, on an early-release schedule. Pre-K and Early Childhood Special Education begin August 17. Autumn Break is November 23–27, Winter Break is December 21–January 1, and Spring Break is March 15–19. Seniors, Pre-K, and ECSE finish May 14; K–11 students finish May 21, also on an early-release schedule.
calendarNotes: The firstDay field follows the broad K–12 calendar, while the lastDay field follows the K–11 calendar because seniors finish earlier; both dates are early release. Pre-K and ECSE begin August 17 and finish May 14. Seniors also finish May 14, while K–11 students continue through May 21. October 14 is no school for Pre-K, and October 15 is a daytime no-class date for Pre-K through grade 6; secondary conferences are held in the evening. October 16, November 3, and May 18 are districtwide no-school days. The regular calendar contains 176 instructional days. Two 18-day Secondary Summer School sessions continue after the regular last day.

whatsNew.title: What's Different From 2025–26
content: The K–12 first day remains August 12 and remains early release, while the Pre-K/ECSE start moves from August 18 to August 17.
Boise retains 176 instructional days with the same 42/43/47/44 period distribution.
The fall conference sequence moves one day earlier: Pre-K is out October 14, Pre-K–6 are out October 15, and the districtwide closure is October 16.
Autumn Break, Winter Break, and Spring Break each shift one calendar day earlier.
The senior, Pre-K, and ECSE last day remains May 14; the K–11 last day shifts from May 22 to May 21.
The 2026–27 source is a revised calendar dated May 11, 2026, rather than the original Board-approved version.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Boise School District start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: K–12 starts Wednesday, August 12, 2026, with early release. Pre-K and ECSE programs start Monday, August 17.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Boise Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. January 4 is a no-school professional-development day, and school resumes January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Which Boise students have no school during fall conferences?
calendarFaqs.a: Pre-K has no school October 14, and Pre-K through grade 6 have no classes October 15. Secondary conferences are evening sessions. All Pre-K–12 students have no school October 16.

calendarFaqs.q: What time is early release in Boise schools?
calendarFaqs.a: Standard elementary schools dismiss at 1:15 p.m., and campuses on Boise’s late-start list dismiss at 1:45 p.m. Junior highs dismiss at noon when elementary schools also release early, while senior highs dismiss at 12:30 p.m. Check your school for any bell-time update.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Boise School District in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Seniors, Pre-K, and ECSE finish May 14. K–11 students finish Friday, May 21, on an early-release schedule.

sourceReviewDetails: Confirmed the program-specific first and last days, conference closures, early releases, breaks, and two secondary summer-school sessions.
Matched school-level early-release times to Boise’s school-hours information and followed the published list of late-start campuses.
The four reporting-period counts total 176 days. Because January 4 is also labeled no school, the event list follows the PDF’s January 5 student return date.
The six high-school graduation entries remain TBD, so no ceremony dates were added.
Summer school remains outside the 176-day regular-year total, and the calendar may change after publication.
